messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: P1 - High GPU queue growth detected in prod-eu-west1 (gpu-pool-3). Autoscaler hitting max_replicas, requests queue > 1200, 95th latency > 2.5s. Paging eng-oncall and eng-sre. https://internal.incidents/1843107890

maria: I'm on it, seeing a sudden ramp starting ~1843107300. Correlates with a model rollout to `text-xxl-v3` in canary. Queue growth mostly read requests with long seq_len.

jamal: thanks. can you confirm autoscaler error? logs show `scale-controller: cannot scale beyond limit (max_replicas=24)`. pool had hard cap from infra change last month.

maria: yep. `kubectl -n inference logs scaler-ctrl | tail -n50` 
```
ERROR scale-controller: desiredReplicas=40, currentLimit=24, reason=QuotaExceeded
WARN warmup: kv-cache warmup tasks started 3x per model shard
```

alyssa: kv-cache warmup spike + longer context lengths in v3 are causing per-request GPU memory pressure and slower eviction — so each replica handles fewer concurrent streams and effective throughput drops.

nik: Was v3 supposed to change context behavior? Product released a config tweak to prefetch KV by default for v3 to reduce cold prefixes. That probably multiplies background work.

jamal: copying mitigation checklist: (1) reduce traffic to v3 canary, (2) bump pool limits if possible, (3) temporary global throttling for heavy customers, (4) revert the kv warmup flag, (5) re-route traffic to v2. Which do we take now?

maria: immediate: stop canary rollout (stop traffic) and flip kv-warmup=false for v3. If that doesn't arrest queue in 5 min, we'll throttle top 10 tenants and request infra to bump max_replicas.

ops-rotation-bot: @maria has assumed on-call. Estimated ETA for escalation to infra: 15m.

maria: Executed: `redwoodctl rollout pause model text-xxl-v3 --canary` — paused. Flipped config: `kv_warmup: false` for v3 canary.

alyssa: confirming: metrics starting to stabilize — queue dropping from 1200 -> 820 in the last 60s. 95th latency down 2.5s -> 1.9s. But still above SLO.

jamal: infra replied: can increase max_replicas but needs approval. Opening emergency PR to bump gpu-pool-3 max_replicas 24->36.

support-bot: Notifying customers in impacted region: identified 12 customers with >5% error rate. Draft message posted to #support.

nik: good. we should keep product folks in the loop — the change to prefetch was intended for long-context accuracy but clearly has side effects. We'll schedule rollback if not stable.

maria: After pause + kv_warmup=false, queue down to 410. We're still seeing some backpressure because existing requests have huge contexts (50k tokens in some edge traces). Running a short script to reject requests > 20k tokens at edge for now.

jamal: can you paste the edge rule?

maria: `envoy filter: reject if request.context_tokens > 20000 -> HTTP 429` applied to prod-eu-west1 gateway. Deployed.

alyssa: interesting find: the canary saw a tiny fraction of traffic that triggered a fallback which enabled `kv_prefetch_threads=8` per model shard (was 1). That multiplier + warmup caused memory churn. We'll add a guard to cap prefetch threads to 2 until we have proper autoscale headroom.

jamal: infra PR merged, max_replicas=36. Autoscaler now able to create new pods but doing so slowly because GPU images pull and KS caches repopulate. Expecting ~8-12m cold start window.

maria: rolling restart of warmup consumers disabled earlier to free memory. Observed drop in OOMs on nodes.

support-bot: Support update sent: "We've mitigated root cause — a model rollout increased background KV warmup and context lengths, producing higher GPU memory per-request and queueing. We've paused rollout and applied temporary throttles. Some customers saw elevated errors; detailed follow-up will be posted."

nik: action item: product to revert the prefetch default and add a runtime flag for canary only. Also require perf smoke test that simulates long sequences before canary promotion.

maria: current KPIs: queue=210, errors dropped to baseline-ish, 95th latency = 1.2s. No new OOMs. Still watching.

sre-manager: good mitigation. We should do a short postmortem and capture: (a) why pool max_replicas was low (b) lack of pre-deploy perf test for kv warmup multiplier (c) edge rule to cap context tokens per request. Schedule RCA 0900 UTC tomorrow.

jamal: tagging infra for follow-up: @infra-team please confirm whether default max_replicas caps are safe for production growth and if we can expose adjustable quotas to SREs.

ops-rotation-bot: handing off to jamal for the rest of the incident timeline. @jamal is now on call.

jamal: I'll continue monitoring and start notes for incident timeline. Thanks everyone.

maria: leaving final note in incident doc and will add traces/graphs.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated (accepting triage). Postmortem scheduled.

maria: quick follow-up: we found one tenant sending batched requests with embedded chat histories accidentally multiplied (client bug). Support is reaching out with mitigation steps.

jamal: adding runbook changes: - increase default autopool limits for prod-eu-west1 - add a preflight that runs a perf harness with kv_warmup on/off - automatic guard to reject >20k tokens at edge unless tenant whitelisted.

sre-manager: closing here; will keep thread open for RCA drafts. Thanks all for quick response. :thumbsup:
